name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel Church
history: Rev. Emmanuel Stabile founded Our Lady of Mount Carmel in 1908 as a mission for Youngstown's Italian immigrants. Its basement was begun in October 1909 and roofed over for Mass until the church was completed and dedicated on 4 November 1916. Pope Francis named it a basilica in 2014.
arch: A red-brick church with a single bell tower topped by a dome.
features: It was listed on the National Register in 1979 for its links to European immigration and for its architecture.
Each year the parish holds an Italian festival.

look.d: The tower's dome is a Youngstown landmark.
For seven years, the parish worshipped in the roofed-over basement.

fun: The parish merged with its founding parish, St. Anthony of Padua, in 2011.
journal: Italian Youngstown built from the basement up. Seven patient years.
